java.method: public static java.util.Map<String,Object> parse(String services, String lru, String meminfo)

inputs.services: dumpsys activity services text or null
inputs.lru: dumpsys activity lru text or null
inputs.meminfo: global dumpsys meminfo text or null

keys.memoryUnit: KiB; legacy *Kb field suffixes retain upstream names
keys.sourcePresence: map services/lru/meminfo booleans: non-null and nonblank input
keys.apps: ordered list of merged AppProcessInfo maps
keys.processes: ordered list of unified process maps, keyed internally by known PID, else exact process name
keys.systemRamInfo: SystemRamInfo map; all known keys present, unavailable values null
keys.diagnostics: list of {source,code,line,message,rawLine}; line is 1-based or null

nullAndZero: Unavailable numeric measurements and missing scalar input fields are null; parsed zero remains numeric zero. observedFields records explicit service fields. hasBound defaults false for legacy compatibility, with observedFields distinguishing absence.
aggregation: PSS is summed once per PID, otherwise once per exact process name. Memory service rows share per-PID PSS; app totals never sum duplicate service copies. All LRU rows retained, app processState/adjLevel use last package LRU record, matching original representative selection.
identity: packageName uses process-name prefix before ':' for named Android app processes; raw processName is retained. Service and LRU known PIDs join memory records; multi-user instances remain observable through process/service UID and user fields.
adaptations: Java17 port, not upstream Java source
Null missing measurements instead of implicit zeros
All LRU process rows preserved instead of package-key overwrite
Service blocks split on record boundaries instead of blank lines
Multiple key=value fields on a line parsed independently
Standard Android isolated UID and app-zygote UID formatting decoded with 99000/90000 bases
Malformed or unsupported records reported in diagnostics
ProcessRecord owner-app plus signed isolated-UID suffix decoded using Android framework formatting
Used RAM inline GPU breakdown accepted
Multi-line connection flags and binding process accepted
LRU spaced state offsets normalize vis+ 3 to vis+3 while adj remains the following importance token
Cross-PID process-name fallback is not applied when a known PID has no PSS sample, preserving unknown memory
Sandbox service instance suffixes such as SandboxedProcessService0:35 are preserved in service and connection names

lruSemantics.oomAdjustment: First LRU OOM bucket token, including normalized numeric offset, e.g. fg or vis+3
lruSemantics.processStateLabel: Second semantic LRU token, e.g. TOP/BFGS/CACC
lruSemantics.legacy: lru/process state and app processState alias oomAdjustment; lru/process adj and app adjLevel alias processStateLabel. Upstream names are preserved despite their inversion.
lruSemantics.isActive: Preserves upstream feature: active service presence first, then legacy first-token prefix classification.
